metaTitle: Word Counter – Free Online Word Count Tool
metaDescription: Count words and characters instantly. Free online word counter for essays, articles, and social media. Get word count, character count, and reading time.

faqs.question: How do I count words in my text?
faqs.answer: Paste your text into the box above. The word count updates instantly as you type or paste.

faqs.question: Does it count characters with or without spaces?
faqs.answer: Both. The tool shows characters with spaces and characters without spaces separately.

faqs.question: How is reading time calculated?
faqs.answer: Reading time is based on an average reading speed of 200–250 words per minute for adults.
